fields.acceptance: A testscript with a root of two projects gets from rhiza inbox --json at the root the merged list with a project field on every item, and inbox approve/open act on an item from the other project, and only one project's part with --project and from inside that project.
fields.statement: rhiza inbox run at the root (or with --all) covers every registered project, each item tagged with its project; run inside a project or with --project <name> it covers only that project.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a root of two projects gets from rhiza roadmap --json at the root each project's milestone groups and backlog under its project name, and only one project's part with --project and from inside that project.
fields.statement: rhiza roadmap run at the root (or with --all) covers every registered project, each item tagged with its project; run inside a project or with --project <name> it covers only that project.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a root of two projects gets from rhiza health --json at the root one block per project plus the machine parts (daemon, disk, usage hold, machine trust) once, exiting 1 when any project's part is bad, and only one project's part with --project and from inside that project.
fields.statement: rhiza health run at the root (or with --all) covers every registered project, each item tagged with its project; run inside a project or with --project <name> it covers only that project.

fields.acceptance: A testscript with a root of two projects gets from rhiza daemon status --json at the root the root daemon once with each project's live runs, last starts and skip reasons, not initialised included, and only one project's part with --project and from inside that project.
fields.statement: rhiza daemon status run at the root (or with --all) covers every registered project, each item tagged with its project; run inside a project or with --project <name> it covers only that project.
